Proxy Sentry CSV 1.5.0

Changes:
- Added standalone Proxy Sentry CSV repository and portable Windows release pipeline.
- Added CSV list persistence, favorites, proxy copy/export actions, search, speed checks, and compact proxy table handling.
- Added Jancy controlled mode with a Proxy Sentry CSV JYL bridge, managed profile launch, close-window support, and sync controls.
- Added installed Windows browser launch providers for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox.
- Added a local no-auth proxy relay for system browsers so authenticated HTTP proxies can launch without native browser username/password prompts.
- Removed the previous built-in Chrome, Camoufox, BrowserForge, fingerprint generator, and hardware-noise UI.
- Reworked layout with a two-row toolbar, a separate sync row, and a bottom log panel.
